tasks.title: Fix resolveRalphRoot() marker
tasks.description:
In src/utils.ts, the resolveRalphRoot() function uses 'lib/ralph_common.sh' as the marker file to detect the ralph repo root. Since ralph_common.sh is being deleted, change the marker to 'package.json' — it's always present and unique to the ralph repo root.

There are 3 occurrences of the marker check in resolveRalphRoot():
1. Line 84: existsSync(join(candidate, 'lib', 'ralph_common.sh'))
2. Line 95: existsSync(join(dir, 'lib', 'ralph_common.sh'))
3. Line 105: existsSync(join(dir, 'lib', 'ralph_common.sh'))

Change all three to check for 'package.json' instead. For example:
  existsSync(join(candidate, 'package.json'))

Update test/utils.test.ts to reflect the new marker. Tests that create fake ralph repo structures with ralph_common.sh should use package.json instead.

Run: bun test test/utils.test.ts
tasks.notes: Changed all 3 ralph_common.sh marker checks to package.json in resolveRalphRoot(). Updated tests: removed the ralph_common.sh and bin/ralph assertions (bin/ralph deleted in task #1), kept package.json check, added src/utils.ts check. All 13 tests pass.

tasks.title: Fix narration server path bug in run.ts
tasks.description:
In src/commands/run.ts, the narration server script path is incorrectly resolved using projectRoot (the target project), but the narration scripts live in the ralph repo's lib/ directory.

Lines 390 and 429 have:
  path.join(projectRoot, 'lib', 'ralph_narrate_server.py')

This should use process.env.RALPH_LIB_DIR (which is set by setupProjectContext to point at the ralph repo's lib/ dir). Change both to:
  path.join(process.env.RALPH_LIB_DIR!, 'ralph_narrate_server.py')

Or alternatively use resolveRalphRoot() + 'lib' — but RALPH_LIB_DIR is already set and is simpler.

Also check if there are similar issues with ralph_narrate.py references in run.ts.

Update test/commands/run.test.ts — tests that mock or assert narration script paths need to match the new path construction.

Run: bun test test/commands/run.test.ts

tasks.title: Update install.sh for compiled binary
tasks.description:
Rewrite install.sh to install the compiled Bun binary instead of the old shell script.

New behavior:
1. Check that 'bun' is available on PATH, error with helpful message if not
2. Run 'bun run build' to compile src/index.ts → dist/ralph
3. Symlink $PREFIX/bin/ralph → $RALPH_ROOT/dist/ralph (instead of bin/ralph)
4. Keep the existing PATH check at the end

The RALPH_ROOT should be derived the same way (cd to script directory, pwd), but point at repo root (the directory containing package.json), not bin/.

Keep the same interface: ./install.sh [prefix], default prefix ~/.local.

tasks.title: Full test suite + build verification
tasks.description:
Run the full verification suite to confirm everything works after the shell-to-TS cutover:

1. Run 'bun test' — all tests must pass (expect 601+ tests)
2. Run 'bun run build' — must compile cleanly to dist/ralph
3. Run './dist/ralph --version' — must print version string

If any tests fail, investigate and fix the root cause. Common issues:
- Tests that reference deleted files (ralph_common.sh, fallback.ts)
- Tests that check for RALPH_FORCE_SHELL behavior
- Tests that assert specific command counts including fallback commands
- Import errors from removed modules

Do NOT skip or delete failing tests — fix them or the code they test.
